company.get.description: Get the Gift Up company associated with the API key.
company.get.title: Get company

gift-cards.get.description: Get one Gift Up gift card by code.
gift-cards.get.title: Get gift card

gift-cards.list.description: List Gift Up gift cards with optional status, SKU, order, email, date, limit, and offset filters.

sku.description: Include only gift cards with this private SKU.

status.description: Include only gift cards in this state.

orderId.description: Include only gift cards for this order GUID.

purchaserEmail.description: Include only gift cards with this purchaser email.

recipientEmail.description: Include only gift cards with this recipient email.

createdOnOrAfter.description: Include gift cards created on or after this UTC datetime.

updatedOnOrAfter.description: Include gift cards updated on or after this UTC datetime.

paymentTransactionId.description: Include gift cards matching this payment provider transaction ID.

gift-cards.list.title: List gift cards

healthcheck.description: Validate the Gift Up API key with GET /company.
healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

orders.list.description: List Gift Up orders with optional createdOnOrAfter, purchaserEmail, source, limit, and offset filters.

createdOnOrAfter.description: Include orders created on or after this UTC datetime.

purchaserEmail.description: Include orders for this purchaser email.

orders.list.title: List orders

orders.notes.add.title: Add order note
orders.notes.add.description: Add a note of up to 500 characters to an existing Gift Up order via POST /orders/{id}/notes.

id.description: Order GUID to attach the note to.

items.create.title: Create item
items.create.description: Create a checkout item (gift card, voucher, or pass) via POST /items.

codes.description: Pre-generated codes issued when this item is sold.

price.description: Amount charged to the purchaser for Specified pricing.

units.description: Unit balance issued for Units-backed items.

value.description: Currency balance issued for Currency-backed items.

detailsURL.description: Absolute http(s) URL with more item information.

availableFrom.description: ISO 8601 datetime when purchase availability starts.

availableUntil.description: ISO 8601 datetime when purchase availability ends.

overrideExpiry.description: Use item-specific expiry instead of account defaults.

additionalTerms.description: Additional terms shown for this item.

expiresInMonths.description: Months after purchase before issued cards expire.

validFromInDays.description: Days after purchase before issued cards become valid.

overrideValidFrom.description: Use item-specific valid-from instead of account defaults.

equivalentValuePerUnit.description: Reporting value per unit for Units-backed items.

item-groups.create.title: Create item group
item-groups.create.description: Create an item group used to organize checkout items via POST /groups.

autoExpand.description: Expand items in this group by default on checkout.

orders.create.title: Create order
orders.create.description: Create an order that issues one or more gift cards via POST /orders.

revenue.description: Total order revenue. Must be positive.

itemDetails.description: Gift card items to issue. At least one is required.

discount.description: Total discount applied to the order.

orderDate.description: UTC ISO 8601 order datetime. Defaults to now.

salesTaxes.description: Sales tax lines for the order.

customFields.description: Custom field values collected with the order.

disableAllEmails.description: When true, Gift Up sends no emails for this order.

items.delete.title: Delete item
items.delete.description: Delete a checkout item by GUID via DELETE /items/{id}.

item-groups.delete.title: Delete item group
item-groups.delete.description: Delete an empty item group by GUID via DELETE /groups/{id}.

webhooks.delete.title: Delete webhook
webhooks.delete.description: Delete a webhook subscription by GUID via DELETE /hooks/{id}.

settings.checkout.get.title: Get checkout settings
settings.checkout.get.description: Retrieve checkout appearance and fee settings via GET /settings/checkout.

settings.email.get.title: Get email settings
settings.email.get.description: Retrieve sender, receipt, and gift-card email settings via GET /settings/email.

settings.gift-card.get.title: Get gift card settings
settings.gift-card.get.description: Retrieve code format, expiry, and display settings via GET /settings/gift-card.

items.get.title: Get item
items.get.description: Retrieve one checkout item by GUID via GET /items/{id}.

orders.get.title: Get order
orders.get.description: Retrieve one order by GUID or order number via GET /orders/{id}.

id.description: Order GUID or presentable order number.

ping.get.title: API health check
ping.get.description: Verify API connectivity with GET /ping, which returns pong and no account data.

reports.transactions.get.title: Get report transaction
reports.transactions.get.description: Retrieve one report transaction by GUID via GET /reports/transactions/{id}.

settings.shipping.get.title: Get shipping settings
settings.shipping.get.description: Retrieve postal delivery settings via GET /settings/shipping.

integrations.stripe.get.title: Get Stripe connection
integrations.stripe.get.description: Retrieve Stripe payment integration settings via GET /integrations/stripe/connection.

webhooks.get.title: Get webhook
webhooks.get.description: Retrieve one webhook subscription by GUID via GET /hooks/{id}.

artwork.list.title: List gift card artwork
artwork.list.description: List uploaded gift card artwork via GET /settings/gift-card/artwork.

item-groups.list.title: List item groups
item-groups.list.description: List checkout item groups via GET /groups.

items.list.title: List items
items.list.description: List checkout items, optionally filtered by groupId, via GET /items.

groupId.description: Only include items in this group GUID.

locations.list.title: List locations
locations.list.description: List physical sale/redemption locations via GET /locations.

reports.transactions.list.title: List report transactions
reports.transactions.list.description: List financial report transactions with optional filters via GET /reports/transactions.

eventOccurredOnOrAfter.description: Include transactions on or after this UTC datetime.

eventOccurredOnOrBefore.description: Include transactions on or before this UTC datetime.

users.list.title: List users
users.list.description: List users with access to the Gift Up account via GET /users.

x_giftup_displayname.description: Override the display name used in API calls.

ping.post.title: Health check (POST)
ping.post.description: Echo an optional JSON payload through POST /ping to verify connectivity.

body.description: Optional JSON body echoed by Gift Up.

gift-cards.reactivate.title: Reactivate gift card
gift-cards.reactivate.description: Reactivate a voided gift card via POST /gift-cards/{code}/reactivate.

reason.description: Reason recorded in the gift card history log.

locationId.description: Location GUID where the event occurred.

metadata.description: Key-value metadata stored on the event.

gift-cards.redeem.title: Redeem gift card
gift-cards.redeem.description: Redeem currency or units from a gift card via POST /gift-cards/{code}/redeem. Provide amount or units.

reason.description: Reason recorded in the gift card history log.

locationId.description: Location GUID where the event occurred.

metadata.description: Key-value metadata stored on the event.

amount.description: Currency amount to redeem for Currency-backed cards.

units.description: Units to redeem for Units-backed cards.

redeemedOn.description: UTC datetime when the redemption occurred.

gift-cards.redeem-in-full.title: Redeem gift card in full
gift-cards.redeem-in-full.description: Redeem the entire remaining balance via POST /gift-cards/{code}/redeem-in-full.

reason.description: Reason recorded in the gift card history log.

locationId.description: Location GUID where the event occurred.

metadata.description: Key-value metadata stored on the event.

webhooks.subscribe.title: Subscribe to webhook
webhooks.subscribe.description: Subscribe a publicly reachable HTTPS URL to a Gift Up event via POST /hooks/{event}/subscribe. Gift Up POSTs {"test": true} and expects HTTP 200 before creating the subscription.

targetUrl.description: HTTPS URL that receives webhook POSTs.

isTestMode.description: When true, the webhook fires only for test-mode events.

gift-cards.top-up.title: Top up gift card
gift-cards.top-up.description: Add currency or units to a gift card via POST /gift-cards/{code}/top-up. Provide amount and/or units. Voided cards return 422.

reason.description: Reason recorded in the gift card history log.

locationId.description: Location GUID where the event occurred.

metadata.description: Key-value metadata stored on the event.

amount.description: Currency amount to add for Currency-backed cards.

units.description: Units to add for Units-backed cards.

gift-cards.undo-redemption.title: Undo gift card redemption
gift-cards.undo-redemption.description: Reverse a prior redemption via POST /gift-cards/{code}/undo-redemption.

reason.description: Reason recorded in the gift card history log.

metadata.description: Key-value metadata stored on the event.

settings.email.update.title: Update email settings
settings.email.update.description: Patch email settings with RFC 6902 operations via PATCH /settings/email. Content-Type must be application/json-patch+json.

operations.description: RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations applied in order.

from.description: JSON Pointer source path for move or copy.

value.description: Value for add, replace, or test operations.

gift-cards.update.title: Update gift card
gift-cards.update.description: Patch gift card properties with RFC 6902 operations via PATCH /gift-cards/{code}. Content-Type must be application/json-patch+json.

operations.description: RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations applied in order.

from.description: JSON Pointer source path for move or copy.

value.description: Value for add, replace, or test operations.

settings.gift-card.update.title: Update gift card settings
settings.gift-card.update.description: Patch gift card settings with RFC 6902 operations via PATCH /settings/gift-card. Content-Type must be application/json-patch+json.

operations.description: RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations applied in order.

from.description: JSON Pointer source path for move or copy.

value.description: Value for add, replace, or test operations.

items.update.title: Update item
items.update.description: Patch a checkout item with RFC 6902 operations via PATCH /items/{id}. Content-Type must be application/json-patch+json.

operations.description: RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations applied in order.

from.description: JSON Pointer source path for move or copy.

value.description: Value for add, replace, or test operations.

item-groups.update.title: Update item group
item-groups.update.description: Patch an item group with RFC 6902 operations via PATCH /groups/{id}. Content-Type must be application/json-patch+json.

operations.description: RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations applied in order.

from.description: JSON Pointer source path for move or copy.

value.description: Value for add, replace, or test operations.

orders.update.title: Update order
orders.update.description: Patch an order with RFC 6902 operations via PATCH /orders/{id}. Content-Type must be application/json-patch+json.

operations.description: RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations applied in order.

from.description: JSON Pointer source path for move or copy.

value.description: Value for add, replace, or test operations.

integrations.stripe.update.title: Update Stripe connection
integrations.stripe.update.description: Create or update Stripe payment credentials via POST /integrations/stripe/connection.

liveSecretKey.description: Stripe live secret key (sk_live_ or rk_live_).

connectAccountId.description: Stripe Connect account ID for marketplace payouts.

reviewAction.description: Action when Stripe flags a payment for review.

createCustomerAccounts.description: Create Stripe Customer objects for buyers.

askForFullAddress.description: Collect a complete billing address at checkout.

artwork.upload.title: Upload gift card artwork
artwork.upload.description: Upload gift card artwork from an absolute image URL or data:image payload via POST /settings/gift-card/artwork.

Url.description: Absolute image URL or data:image payload. Minimum 576x384 PNG/GIF/JPG.

replaceAllExistingArtwork.description: When true, delete existing artwork first.

gift-cards.void.title: Void gift card
gift-cards.void.description: Void a gift card so it cannot be redeemed via POST /gift-cards/{code}/void.

reason.description: Reason recorded in the gift card history log.

locationId.description: Location GUID where the event occurred.

metadata.description: Key-value metadata stored on the event.
